cards.title: GFCI Protection Requirements
cards.summary: Ground-Fault Circuit Interrupter (GFCI) protection is required for 125 V to 250 V receptacles in a dwelling's bathrooms, kitchens, garages, outdoors, basements, laundry areas, within 6 ft of sinks, and near bathtubs and showers, and for the outlets that supply dishwashers.
cards.keyRule: 125 V to 250 V receptacles in these dwelling locations need GFCI protection.

cards.title: AFCI Protection Requirements
cards.summary: Arc-Fault Circuit Interrupter (AFCI) protection is required for 120 V, 15 A and 20 A branch circuits that serve the dwelling-unit rooms the code lists: bedrooms, living rooms, kitchens, dining rooms, hallways, closets, laundry areas and similar rooms.
cards.keyRule: AFCI protection is required in the listed habitable rooms of dwelling units.

cards.title: Wire Gauge & Breaker Sizing
cards.summary: Wire gauge must match the breaker amperage: 14 AWG max 15A, 12 AWG max 20A, 10 AWG max 30A, 8 AWG max 40A, 6 AWG max 55A. Never put a smaller wire on a larger breaker.

cards.title: Required Branch Circuits
cards.summary: Dwelling units need 20 A circuits for the bathroom receptacles and the laundry receptacle, and at least two 20 A small-appliance circuits for the kitchen countertop and nearby eating areas.
cards.keyRule: Bathroom, laundry, and kitchen small-appliance circuits are 20 A circuits of their own.

cards.title: Receptacle Spacing Rules
cards.summary: Wall receptacles: no point more than 6 feet from an outlet (max 12 feet between outlets). Countertop receptacles: no point more than 24 inches from an outlet. Islands and peninsulas 24"x12" or larger need at least one outlet.
cards.keyRule: Walls: 6ft rule (12ft max spacing). Countertops: 24-inch rule.

cards.title: Residential Load Calculation
cards.summary: Standard method: General lighting at 3 VA/sq ft + small-appliance circuits at 1,500 VA each + laundry at 1,500 VA. Apply Table 220.42 demand factors: first 3,000 VA at 100%, remainder at 35%. Add dryer (5,000 VA) and range (8,000 VA demand) at 100%.
cards.keyRule: 3 VA/sq ft lighting + 1,500 VA per SA circuit + demand factors from Table 220.42

cards.title: Grounding Electrode System
cards.summary: All grounding electrodes present at a building must be bonded together. Common electrodes: metal underground water pipe (10ft+ contact), ground rods (8ft, 5/8" diameter), concrete-encased electrode (Ufer ground). The grounding electrode conductor connects the system to earth.
cards.keyRule: All present electrodes must be bonded together to form the grounding electrode system.

cards.title: Panel Design Basics
cards.summary: Panelboards must not exceed their bus rating. All circuits must be identified in a directory. Working space: 30" wide, 36" deep, 6.5' high minimum. Balance loads between bus sides. Main breaker must handle the calculated service load.
cards.keyRule: Panel directory required. Do not exceed bus rating. Maintain working clearance.

cards.title: NM Cable Installation
cards.summary: NM (Romex) cable must be secured within 12 inches of every box and at intervals not exceeding 4.5 feet. When more than 2 NM cables pass through the same hole in framing that is sealed with insulation, caulk or foam, ampacity must be derated per Table 310.15(C)(1).
cards.keyRule: Secure within 12" of boxes, every 4.5 ft. Derate when bundling 3+ cables in a sealed opening.
